notes.content:
Look, it's two for one!

- Fixed the russian localisation (by MilesFox92)
- Improved Font Rendering performance:
The HUD won't affect the frame rate anymore
- Improved minigun shooting performance:
No more frame rate drops when spawning hit effects

SteeringVelocity.Force <bool>
SteeringVelocity.Value <float>

Have fun! ːsmileyflagː

notes.title: Update 1.5.42
notes.content:
Update 1.5.42 has been released!

- Fixed car camera positions (by RetroGamer).
- Race track collisions fixed (by Freed8m).
- Fixed smoothing issue on the spectran's second tuning bumper (by Freed8m).
- Fixed tile models: crossing2.p3d, arenastr.p3d, arenacurve2.p3d (by Freed8m).
- Added pickups into the radar.
- Sync car lights state in multiplayer.
- Always show the xbox buttons when using a gamepad.
- Prevent the game from crashing when there's no output device available.
- Fixed the checkpoint area rotation. 
- Added full support for wheels.
- Added ForceFeedback support.
- Resurrected TrackIR support.
- Keep all the device configurations in the config file.
- Allow the camera rotation in different camera views.
- Allow different air control styles with the gamepad.
- Added the manual shifting option in the control settings.
- Show the current gear onto the HUD when using the manual shifting.
- Added "Black Stripes 2" for the Judge, "Blue Stripes" for the the Ironhorze, and "Impact Turbo" for the Hunter (by Freed8m)

- Added a new car to the game (by Freed8m)
Icebreaker RALLYE'68

notes.title: Update 1.5.40
notes.content:
1.5.40 has been released on Steam

[BugFix] Disable FSAA by default
[BugFix] Improve game performance

[Bugfix] Fix a crash that occurs when playing solo after a 4vs4 match.

- Fix Hunter's backlights being flipped.

notes.title: Update 1.5.36
notes.content:
- Mod Testing: Use F10 to show car debug informations.
- Mod Testing: Use LShift+S to toggle slow motion.
- Mod Testing: Use LShift+O to explode the car.
- Fix gamma ramp calculation NaN.
- Fix morning ambience texture (Thanks to Mica).
- Fix various memory leaks.
- Added game.config option to set maximum supported tracks in menu (no more 511 limit). Check MaxTrackCount.
- Added game.config option to change odometer color.
- Added Mica's sunset ambience (Thanks to Mica).
- Added experimental support to new track format (v2.0) which allow integrating game.dbs inside track files.
- Added game.dbs variables to toggle HUD & radar elements (HUD.HidePlayerNames ,HUD.HidePlayerMainScore, HUD.HidePlayerList, HUD.HideRadarPlayers, HUD.HideLeadingMessages, HUD.HideTargetArrow).
- Added game.dbs variable to enable gear indicator in tachometer (HUD.EnableGearIndicator).
- Added all game files available for all languages. Faster language change, without downloading any files from Steam.
- Fix initial RPM indicator when you start a race.
- Fix race interruption when default ambience is missing; force to day.amb in that case.
- Added the possibility to tweak garage ambience and default car.
- Fixed number of minigun ammo in "The Right One For The Job?" event.
- Increased max texture limit to 2048.

notes.title: Crashday Redline Edition - Update 1.5.26
notes.content:
Hey Crashday fans,

The latest patch 1.5.26 for Crashday Redline Edition is now live on Steam!

Here's what's new in 1.5.26
---------------------------

[Crashfix] Fixed crash with pickups in career mode when restarting events (reported by THE KOKS XXL).
[Crashfix] Fixed random crash when playing multiplayer HTF.
[Crashfix] Fixed random crash while spectating.
[Crashfix] Fixed multiplayer browser crash.
[Crashfix] Fixed random crash in multiplayer lobby.
[Crashfix] Fixed track editor crash when making a new track from delete CP view.
[Bugfix] Fixed resolution being too big on first start.
[Bugfix] Fixed bug that makes the game stuck after disabling mods (savegame invalidation).
[Bugfix] Fixed view range option issue that couldn't be changed.
[Bugfix] Fixed multiplayer car classes for default presets.
[Bugfix] Fixed game getting stuck when track finishes to play.
[Feature] Added support for non XInput controllers.
[Feature] Added the possibility to re-binding acceleration, brake and steer controls for gamepads.
[Feature] Added time-based bomb run mode for career mods.

NOTE about gamepads:
If your gamepad is not recognized by the game there are some steps to follow in order to make it work.

The game now loads a custom gamepad database located in C:\Users\<username>\AppData\Local\config\gamecontrollerdb.txt.
To add new gamepads you can use http://www.generalarcade.com/gamepadtool/ which is well explained in their page!

Another useful link is https://github.com/gabomdq/SDL_GameControllerDB

Cheers

The Moonbyte Team

notes.title: Crashday Redline Edition - Update 1.5.23
notes.content:
The first patch of Crashday Redline Edition is now available!

Here's what's new in 1.5.23
-------------------------------------

[Bugfix] Fix issue with initiating DirectX9 devices when Windows is set to >100% DPI scale
[Bugfix] Fix Crash caused by Soundtracks on startup ("Could not open ***.ogg")
[Bugfix] Fix Crash on launcher when loading config
[Bugfix] Fix crash when starting an event after becoming host
[Bugfix] Steam cloud synchronization could lead to start-up problems; synchronization now disabled for hardware-specific configuration files
[Bugfix] Achievements: Fix "Win" Achievements not being tracked correctly
[Bugfix] Achievements: fixed the score values associated with Stunt Score achievements
[Bugfix] Stats: Fix "Total Games Played" and "Total Losses" statistics
[Bugfix] Fix password filtering
[Bugfix] HUD: limit name length on player list
[Bugfix] Fix typo in russian "Goldstunt" message
[Bugfix] Fixed Offroad Style 2 tire cost
[Bugfix] Fixed Professionals1 issue with unclosed walls
[Bugfix] Specific Car not appearing in the browser
[Bugfix] Fix antiflood protection timer
[Tweak] Now rendering "Continue" Button in Cutscenes all of the time
[Tweak] Hide ".trk" track extension in multiplayer browser and MP lobby
[New feature] Ability to show Steam Group clan tags in front of names
[New feature] Ability to disable anti-flood system in game.dbs
[Localization] Various smaller fixes for russian localization


Upcoming patches
-------------------------
We are already working hard on the next patches and hope to soon include fixes for problems like MP issue "Game could not be started", MP damage mismatch between client and hosts, performance issues and achievement tweaks.


We like to say thank you for the positive feedback and community input Crashday has so far on Steam! We're more than happy to see this and hope we can make the game even better for all of you :)


All the best,

everyone of the Moonbyte Team
